text:
maria.g: follow-up from the quant RFC — i sketched a compact "artifact" schema + a short ops runbook that ties sampling, cost accounting, and safe explainability collection together. want a quick sanity check before i PR.

samir: quick read done. high-level: are we trying to make this the canonical source for all low-bit regressions + mitigation actions?

maria.g: yes. single schema consumers: console timeline, alerts, and nightly chargeback reports. aim is small payloads for hot-path emission + optional heavy explainability offload.

aj: ops request: show a concrete json example and a prometheus label set. also need a field that indicates whether this was observed in production traffic vs shadow sampling.

maria.g: good call. included fields: environment, sampling_mode {hot,shadow,canary}, and sampling_rate. here's the prototype i used in the demo:

```json
"artifact_event": "model=redwood-v2-xl, profile_id=fp8-sane-2026-11, profile_version=5, route=/completion/v1, event_id=evt-20261115-99, observed_at=2026-11-15T16:02:11Z, environment=prod, sampling_mode=hot, sampling_rate=0.01, severity_bucket=high, degrade_score=0.78, quant_sensitivity=0.44, fidelity_budget=0.10, degradation_signature=token_sparse_saturation, quality_anchor=anchor_v3, anchor_examples=[short_req_1,long_task_7], token_index=31, residual_norm=0.054, kv_cache_diff=false, sample_snippet="[redacted] the meeting is on tuesday", redaction_performed=true, metadata_ttl_seconds=1209600, sample_ttl_seconds=259200, explainability_collected=false, explainability_uri=gs://redwood-quant/2026/evt-20261115-99, collect_cost_ms=0.6, collect_size_bytes=24576, estimated_charge_units=0.003"
```

li: nit: prefer snake_case for the final schema. add fields: customer_id_hash, customer_tier, canary_flag, and fallback_triggered boolean. also add a compact label set for metrics: label_set=["model","profile_id","route","severity_bucket","customer_tier","sampling_mode"].

maria.g: will switch to snake_case; added fallback_triggered and customer_tier in examples.

jenna: product ask: can we include an "action_suggestion" field that the console can surface (e.g., increase_shadow_sampling, rollback_profile, schedule_ablation_test) so oncall has a proposed next step?

maria.g: added action_suggestion (free-text) and action_recommended_by enum {telemetry,ops,ml}. also adding an "artifact_resolution" event type for the close-the-loop record with resolution_reason enum {auto_rollback,manual_rollforward,profile_tweak,noop,false_positive}.

ops-bot: /observe quant_artifacts --since 2h --severity_bucket=high --group-by route,profile_id

aj: ops requirement: sample_snippet must be redacted client-side; redact pipeline must be verifiable. also, when explainability_collected=true, tag collect_latency_ms and storage_bytes in the metadata so finance can bill.

vela: security note: explainability artifacts may contain model gradients/pointer data; require admin-only ACL + HSM-backed KMS keys for storage. audit every retrieval.

maria.g: agreed on admin-only retrieval and audit logs. i'll add explainability_acl and explainability_audit_event in the PR.

samir: tradeoff Q: what should default sampling_rate be for "hot"? too aggressive and we blow up cost.

jenna: product suggests defaults: hot=0.001, shadow=0.05, canary=1.0 for targeted canary customers. include guidance: enable explainability only for canaries with canary_flag=true.

maria.g: note added. also a tiny microbenchmark: collecting explainability (token-level diffs + saliency) measured ~0.45-0.8ms overhead p99 and ~18-30kb per artifact; we recommend default explainability_collected=false.

aj: alert sketch we can wire immediately: WHEN quant_degrade_p95 > 0.72 for 15m AND severity_bucket in (high) THEN page oncall with top 5 anchor_examples + action_suggestion + link to sample diff; AUTO: add profile to increased_shadow_sampling for 1h.

li: ops telemetry ask: emit both a compact metric line and the event blob. compact metric labels should be emitted at ingestion so alerts don't parse payloads.

maria.g: done. schema doc will include an ingestion shim that emits: quant.artifact.count{label_set}, quant.degrade.histogram, quant.residual_norm.avg.

vela: compliance ask: ensure PII scrubber runs before any sample_snippet leaves the service; maintain provenance header with scrubber_version.

maria.g: will add redaction_version and redaction_passes fields to the payload.

samir: final Q: how do we prevent noisy churn from bumping SLA-sensitive endpoints? propose a hysteresis rule: only trigger auto-rollbacks when degrade_score sustained above threshold and artifact_count > N within window.

maria.g: adding hysteresis fields: sustain_window_seconds and min_event_count. default sustain_window=600s, min_event_count=5. will include suggested thresholds in runbook.

aj: one more ops point: provide a tiny backfill script to annotate older traces with profile_version and to retrocompute degrade_score when possible.

maria.g: will include backfill utility in PR. plan: open PR with snake_case schema, console mockups (diff + timeline + suggested actions), ingestion shim that emits compact labels, ACL + audit for explainability, microbench numbers, and a short runbook (redaction, TTLs, hysteresis). tagging reviewers: @samir @aj @li @jenna @vela :raised_hands:
